root_cause: The GOVUK Tabs component treats ArrowDown as a horizontal navigation key, causing focus to move to the next tab when the down arrow is pressed. Only ArrowLeft and ArrowRight should change tab selection for a horizontal tab list.
repair_strategy: Modify the keydown handler in the tabs component to ignore ArrowUp and ArrowDown keys, allowing only ArrowLeft and ArrowRight to trigger tab switching.
expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing ArrowDown while focus is on a tab will no longer change the selected tab; focus will remain on the current tab, preserving the panel visibility as required.
functional_risks: If the tabs component is used in a vertical orientation, ArrowDown/ArrowUp may be expected to navigate; this change could break that use case.
Future updates to the component that rely on the previous key handling logic may need adjustment.
verification_requirements: Verify that ArrowLeft and ArrowRight still move focus between tabs correctly.
Verify that ArrowDown and ArrowUp do not change focus or selected tab.
Ensure that the tab panels remain associated with their tabs (aria-controls, aria-selected) after key presses.
